cameras.autoTrackingNote: Built-in AI Tracking 2.0: Only Me, Auto Zoom and Group Tracking, recognizing people plus 30+ animal and 200+ object categories. No external PC required.
cameras.description: An AI-tracking PTZR live-production camera built on a 1/1.5-inch CMOS sensor with a 5x optical zoom and a 81 to 18 degree horizontal field of view, shooting 4K at 60fps. Its motorized head adds a 90-degree lens roll to pan and tilt for vertical 4K, and its built-in AI Tracking 2.0 follows people, animals and objects without an external PC. It carries pro-AV connectivity including 3G-SDI, HDMI 2.0, USB-C and IP with NDI|HX3, SRT, RTSP and RTMP, plus VISCA over IP and RS-232 control, FreeD output and PoE+. It is battery-powered and targets solo live production and virtual sets.
